meta.run: September 2026 supplier payment run, Harbourline Studio Ltd
meta.layout: One record per inbox message, R01 to R12 in inbox order (oldest first). Figures are as stated in each email. extractor_decision is a proposal (pay, hold or exclude) for the reconciler to confirm. PO variance, bank feed and supplier master checks are not done at this stage: the extractor sees only the inbox. Back-references (voided_by, superseded_by, duplicate_resent_as) and forward references (voids, corrects, duplicates) point to record ids.

records.decision_reason: valid invoice received in September; gross 1,488.00 GBP is at or under 2,000.00, so no approval needed
records.notes: Autumn brochure print run, 500 copies. Terms 30 days. Supplier states its bank details are unchanged from previous invoices.

records.decision_reason: voided by the supplier in R03 (raised in error)
records.notes: Courier delivery for the brochure run. Supplier says delivery was already included in the price agreed on PO-1041. Reconciler: confirm in the bank feed that 114.00 GBP was not paid before the void.

records.decision_reason: notice, not an invoice; it voids INV-000488 (R02)
records.notes: Supplier says INV-000488 was raised in error, has been voided on its system and nothing is due against it. Sent from the same address as R01, R02, R07 and R08.

records.decision_reason: supplier says it already refunded 300.00 GBP; the bank feed decides (policy 7)
records.notes: Credit note against MD-2026-049 (August invoice, paid 28 Aug 2026): five hours overbilled. Supplier says it refunded 300.00 GBP by bank transfer on 9 Sep 2026 with reference CN-012 and that nothing further is due from us. That is a claim only. If the refund is in the bank feed, nothing is offset. If it is not, offset 300.00 GBP against the next payment to Marlow (MD-2026-057, R06). No date is printed on the credit note itself.

records.decision_reason: invoiced in USD but the run is made in GBP from the main current account (policy 2); not covered by the policy, so reserved for the principal (policy 10)
records.notes: Cloud hosting, plan Team-M, service 1 to 30 Sep 2026. Email says 'Amount due: USD 960.00' and 'Tax: none (reverse charge, customer to account for VAT)', so net and gross are both 960.00 USD and VAT charged is 0.00. No GBP amount or exchange rate is given. Email says to pay by wire to the USD account on file: reconciler to check what the supplier master holds for Kestrel. Due 12 Oct 2026, after the run date, but received in September.

records.decision_reason: valid invoice received in September; gross 5,400.00 GBP is over 2,000.00, so principal approval is needed before it is scheduled (policy 3)
records.notes: Brand refresh, phase 2 (guidelines, templates, asset library). Re-sent on 22 Sep as R09, identical figures: pay once. Due 15 Oct 2026 is after the run date, but the invoice was received in September so policy 1 puts it in this run. If CN-012 (R04) is offset, the payment is 5,100.00 GBP gross.

records.decision_reason: superseded by the corrected version R08 (policy 5)
records.notes: First version. Business cards, 10 boxes 150.00 GBP; letterheads, 2,000 sheets 160.50 GBP (mis-keyed, per the supplier). Terms 30 days.

records.decision_reason: latest version of INV-000491 supersedes R07 (policy 5); gross 378.60 GBP is at or under 2,000.00, so no approval needed
records.notes: Same invoice number re-issued 17 Sep 2026 (invoice date 16 Sep on the original). Letterheads, 2,000 sheets corrected to 165.50 GBP (2 x 82.75 per thousand); business cards unchanged at 150.00 GBP. Against R07: net +5.00, VAT +1.00, gross +6.00. PO-1044 is carried from R07; the correction email does not restate it. Terms unchanged, due 16 Oct 2026.

records.email_subject: Re: Invoice MD-2026-057, brand refresh phase 2 (PO-1039)
records.decision_reason: duplicate of R06; an invoice number is paid at most once (policy 5)
records.notes: Supplier resent MD-2026-057 'in case last week's email didn't reach you' and says it is the same invoice with nothing changed. Figures match R06 exactly.

records.decision_reason: statement, not an invoice (policy 1); balance is 0.00 GBP
records.notes: Statement for customer 20917. Opening balance 1 Sep 142.80 GBP; 3 Sep payment received -142.80 GBP (ref EO-55120); balance outstanding at 24 Sep 0.00 GBP. Automatically generated, no action required. No invoice attached.

records.email_subject: URGENT: updated bank details for payments
records.decision_reason: principal answered REJECT: request refused, details on file stand, pay Northfield to the details on file (policy 8)

principal_answer.text: Do not update the details. Pay Northfield to the details on file. I will call them on the number on file; treat the .co email as suspected fraud.

records.notes: Unverified email asking Harbourline to change Northfield Print Ltd's payment details to the account above and to confirm by reply. Sender domain is northfield-print.co; the five other Northfield messages (R01, R02, R03, R07, R08) come from northfield-print.co.uk. Signed 'D. Kaur' where the others are signed Dee Kaur. Subject marked URGENT, and it says payments to the old account after 30 Sep will bounce and cost a re-issue fee. It claims Finance Director approval on 25 Sep (ref FD-0925): unverified, and under policy 8 an email is never sufficient. R01 (2 Sep) said Northfield's bank details were unchanged. Not actioned: supplier master untouched, no reply sent, no supplier contact (policy 9). Escalated to the principal by the extractor (options CALLBACK or DECLINE). Principal answered REJECT (mail #6): do not update the details, pay Northfield to the details on file, treat the .co email as suspected fraud; the principal will phone Northfield on the number on file. Closed.

records.email_subject: Autumn catalogue: 15% off desk essentials until 31 October
records.notes: Autumn catalogue promotion, 15% off desk essentials, paper and toner until 31 Oct with a discount code. No amount due.
